companies.label: Meituan
companies.metric_name: Core Local Commerce segment operating profit/(loss)
companies.metric_basis: Company-disclosed quarterly operating profit for the Core Local Commerce segment (food delivery + in-store + Meituan Instashopping/instant retail combined), as reported in Meituan's quarterly results announcements

periods.src: Meituan Q3 2025 results release (meituan.com, 2025-11-14): "核心本地商业经营亏损141亿元"
Meituan FY2025 annual results (2026-03-26): "核心本地商业经营亏损69-100亿元区间" per 雪球/新浪财经 recap of full-year filing
中国日报网 2026-06-01 recap of Meituan Q1 2026 results: "核心本地商业经营亏损20亿元，环比减亏96亿元"

Meituan Q2 2026 results/earnings call recap (知乎/新浪财经, Aug-Sep 2026): op profit RMB5.7bn vs RMB3.7bn prior year (+52.3% YoY); margin +7.9% vs Q1's -3.2% after regulators halted blanket subsidies in June 2026

companies.latest_signal: Core local commerce swung back to a RMB5.7bn profit in Q2 2026 (margin +7.9%) after the June 2026 regulatory crackdown on indiscriminate subsidies, but September 2026 data cited by Chinese trade press show in-store GTV growth decelerating to single digits (-13% QoQ), suggesting the Q3 2026 print (due late Nov 2026, not yet released) will test whether the profit recovery holds as top-line growth cools too.

companies.label: JD.com
companies.metric_name: New Businesses (新业务) segment operating loss
companies.metric_basis: Company-disclosed quarterly operating loss for the New Businesses segment, which bundles JD Takeaway/food delivery with JD Property, Jingxi and overseas operations

periods.src: JD Q3 2025 results, released 2025-11-14 (新浪财经/东方财富: "新业务亏损157.36亿元")
JD FY2025 annual results, released 2026-03-05 (腾讯新闻: "新业务经营损失148亿元，2024年四季度为亏损8.85亿元")
JD Q1 2026 results, ~2026-05-12 (虎嗅/东方财富: "新业务一季度亏掉103.52亿元，同比扩大近7倍")
JD Q2 2026 results, 2026-08-13 (腾讯新闻/网易: "新业务运营亏损98.54亿元，上年同期为147.77亿元")

companies.latest_signal: JD's new-business loss narrowed both sequentially (RMB15.7bn → RMB9.9bn since Q3 2025) and year-over-year in Q2 2026 (vs RMB14.8bn in Q2 2025), with management (CEO Xu Ran) saying full-year 2026 delivery investment would run below 2025 levels as order mix shifts toward full-meal orders; JD remains the clear #3 with ~15% delivery share versus Meituan's ~43% and Taobao Flash's ~42%.

war_summary: After roughly RMB150bn in combined annual subsidy spend pushed combined daily delivery/instant-retail orders past 200m, all three platforms' own disclosed loss lines have narrowed in the most recent 1-2 quarters as Beijing's regulators pressured 'involution'-style blanket subsidies (including a draft 10-point subsidy-conduct rule) and each company pivoted toward order-economics discipline: Meituan's core local commerce flipped to a RMB5.7bn profit in Q2 2026, Alibaba's Taobao Flash loss has shrunk every quarter since a ~RMB36.7bn trough in Q3 2025, and JD's new-business loss is down to ~RMB9.9bn from a ~RMB15.7bn peak. Share has stabilized (Meituan ~43%, Taobao Flash ~42%, JD ~15%) with no one yet exiting — Meituan is defending turf, Alibaba is buying ecosystem share while guiding to FY2029 profitability, and JD is the most willing to keep bleeding to stay relevant — so the fight is cooling in intensity but not over.
